scope: VQGAN reconstruction metrics for all matched-padded packet policies; no transformer inference
decoder_mapping: raw VQGAN output y; no extra normalization
metrics: raw-output PSNR against original; clamp/normalize=True LPIPS; clamp->PIL->official preprocessing CLIP cosine
exact_id_reuse: Within image, an endpoint exactly equal to original sender IDs reuses the deterministic clean-reference metrics under identical frozen weights/input/metric identity. Store this origin per row and count actual decoder forwards separately.
aggregation: Each SNR requires all 50 frames and all three policies. Average five trials within image, then ten images; retain every policy. Incomplete groups report coverage only.
limitations: Ten old Imagenette development images, not an ImageNet100 evaluation
These metrics do not implement matched-padded MaskGIT/CMI recovery
Feedback/header/CMI transmission cost and latency remain unmodeled
